known_issues: Motoko syntax error in gateway/main.mo at line 40: unexpected 'actor' token
Gateway canister deployment failing due to compilation errors
Canister has no wasm module error when calling registerDevice

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the Motoko syntax error at line 40 in src/gateway/main.mo where an unexpected 'actor' token is causing compilation to fail. The error message states: 'syntax error [M0001], unexpected token 'actor', expected one of token or <phrase> sequence: <typ_un>'. Resolve the type annotation or declaration issue that is preventing the gateway canister from compiling.

Ensure the gateway canister deploys successfully and has a valid wasm module so that canister calls like 'dfx canister call gateway registerDevice' work without the 'IC0537: Requested canister has no wasm module' error.
